description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git check-ignore' command, encompassing various test cases for ignore patterns, path handling, symlinks, submodules, global ignores, and input streams.

methods.name: init_vars
methods.description: Initializes testing environment variables related to ignore files.

methods.name: enable_global_excludes
methods.description: Enables global ignore file configuration for Git.

methods.name: expect_in
methods.description: Sets expected output for stdout or stderr.

methods.name: expect_from_stdin
methods.description: Sets expected output for stdin based inputs.

methods.name: broken_c_unquote
methods.description: Converts escaped C strings to raw strings for comparison.

methods.name: broken_c_unquote_verbose
methods.description: Converts verbose escaped C strings to raw strings.

methods.name: stderr_contains
methods.description: Checks if stderr contains a specific pattern.

methods.name: stderr_empty_on_success
methods.description: Validates that stderr is empty on successful tests.

methods.name: test_check_ignore
methods.description: Runs the 'git check-ignore' command with specified arguments and validates the exit code and output.

methods.name: test_expect_success_multi
methods.description: Runs multiple success tests with different verbosity levels.

methods.name: test_expect_success_no_index_multi
methods.description: Runs multiple success tests ignoring the index cache.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up the test environment with multiple ignore scenarios including submodules, symlinks, global excludes, stdin inputs, and complex pattern matching.
